tools.name: evaluate_domain

tools.name: evaluate_name
tools.description: Score a bare brand or product name 0-100 across structure, phonetics, brand, and meaning — no domain or TLD involved. Use this when the user is choosing or comparing names before picking a domain; use evaluate_domain once a domain is chosen. Free without a credential (daily per-IP limit), one quota

tools.name: evaluate_logo
tools.description: Beta — score a logo image 0-100 on simplicity, small-size (favicon) readability, memorability, versatility (monochrome/dark backgrounds), and industry fit. Provide the image as base64 in image_base64 with format, or as a public http(s) url the server fetches (PNG/JPEG, 2 MB at most). Optional brand_

tools.name: evaluate_domains
tools.description: Batch-score up to 10 domains in one call and get per-domain evaluations plus an aggregate summary (top scorer, mean score). Malformed entries come back as per-item errors. For a single name use evaluate_domain. Costs one quota unit per evaluated domain.

tools.name: compare_domains
tools.description: Score 2-10 candidate domains and rank them: winner, score margin, and each name's strongest and weakest scoring group. Use when choosing between name options.

tools.name: suggest_domains
tools.description: Generate candidate names from keywords, keep the ones RDAP reports as available, and score up to 8 of them. Use for brainstorming alternatives or when a name is taken.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Best-effort RDAP registration check for one domain: available, taken (with registration date when the registry publishes it), or unknown. Free — no credential, no quota.
